verses.original: Τότε ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀνήχθη εἰς τὴν ἔρημον ὑπὸ τοῦ Πνεύματος πειρασθῆναι ὑπὸ τοῦ διαβόλου
verses.transliteration: Tote ho Iēsous anēchthē eis tēn erēmon hypo tou Pneumatos peirasthēnai hypo tou diabolou
verses.literal: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil

verses.original: καὶ νηστεύσας ἡμέρας τεσσεράκοντα καὶ τεσσεράκοντα νύκτας ὕστερον ἐπείνασεν
verses.transliteration: kai nēsteusas hēmeras tesserakonta kai tesserakonta nyktas hysteron epeinasen
verses.literal: After fasting forty days and forty nights He was hungry

verses.original: Καὶ προσελθὼν ὁ πειράζων εἶπεν αὐτῷ Εἰ Υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰπὲ ἵνα οἱ λίθοι οὗτοι ἄρτοι γένωνται
verses.transliteration: Kai proselthōn ho peirazōn eipen autō Ei Huios ei tou Theou eipe hina hoi lithoi houtoi artoi genōntai
verses.literal: The tempter came to Him and said If You are the Son of God tell . . . these stones to become bread

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Γέγραπται Οὐκ ἐπ’ ἄρτῳ μόνῳ ζήσεται ὁ ἄνθρωπος Ἀλλ’ ἐπὶ παντὶ ῥήματι ἐκπορευομένῳ διὰ στόματος Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ho de apokritheis eipen Gegraptai Ouk ep’ artō monō zēsetai ho anthrōpos All’ epi panti rhēmati ekporeuomenō dia stomatos Theou
verses.literal: But Jesus answered . . . It is written Man . . . shall not live on bread alone but on every word that comes from the mouth of God

verses.original: Τότε παραλαμβάνει αὐτὸν ὁ διάβολος εἰς τὴν ἁγίαν πόλιν καὶ ἔστησεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸ πτερύγιον τοῦ ἱεροῦ
verses.transliteration: Tote paralambanei auton ho diabolos eis tēn hagian polin kai estēsen auton epi to pterygion tou hierou
verses.literal: Then the devil took Him to the holy city and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Εἰ Υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ Θεοῦ βάλε σεαυτὸν κάτω γέγραπται γὰρ ὅτι Τοῖς ἀγγέλοις αὐτοῦ ἐντελεῖται περὶ σοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ χειρῶν ἀροῦσίν σε μή‿ ποτε προσκόψῃς πρὸς λίθον τὸν πόδα σου
verses.transliteration: kai legei autō Ei Huios ei tou Theou bale seauton katō gegraptai gar hoti Tois angelois autou enteleitai peri sou kai epi cheirōn arousin se mē pote proskopsēs pros lithon ton poda sou
verses.literal: If You are the Son of God he said throw Yourself down For it is written He will command - His angels concerning You and they will lift You up in their hands so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone

verses.original: Ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Πάλιν γέγραπται Οὐκ ἐκπειράσεις Κύριον τὸν Θεόν σου
verses.transliteration: Ephē autō ho Iēsous Palin gegraptai Ouk ekpeiraseis Kyrion ton Theon sou
verses.literal: Jesus replied - It is also written Do not put . . . the Lord your God to the test

verses.original: Πάλιν παραλαμβάνει αὐτὸν ὁ διάβολος εἰς ὄρος ὑψηλὸν λίαν καὶ δείκνυσιν αὐτῷ πάσας τὰς βασιλείας τοῦ κόσμου καὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Palin paralambanei auton ho diabolos eis oros hypsēlon lian kai deiknysin autō pasas tas basileias tou kosmou kai tēn doxan autōn
verses.literal: Again the devil took Him to a very high mountain and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ταῦτά σοι πάντα δώσω ἐὰν πεσὼν προσκυνήσῃς μοι
verses.transliteration: kai eipen autō Tauta soi panta dōsō ean pesōn proskynēsēs moi
verses.literal: All this I will give You he said if You will fall down and worship me

verses.original: Τότε λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ὕπαγε Σατανᾶ γέγραπται γάρ Κύριον τὸν θεόν σου προσκυνήσεις καὶ αὐτῷ μόνῳ λατρεύσεις
verses.transliteration: Tote legei autō ho Iēsous Hypage Satana gegraptai gar Kyrion ton theon sou proskynēseis kai autō monō latreuseis
verses.literal: Away from Me Satan Jesus told him For it is written Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only

verses.original: Τότε ἀφίησιν αὐτὸν ὁ διάβολος καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄγγελοι προσῆλθον καὶ διηκόνουν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Tote aphiēsin auton ho diabolos kai idou angeloi prosēlthon kai diēkonoun autō
verses.literal: Then the devil left Him and angels came and ministered to Him

verses.original: Ἀκούσας δὲ ὅτι Ἰωάννης παρεδόθη ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν
verses.transliteration: Akousas de hoti Iōannēs paredothē anechōrēsen eis tēn Galilaian
verses.literal: When Jesus heard that John had been imprisoned He withdrew to Galilee

verses.original: καὶ καταλιπὼν τὴν Ναζαρὰ ἐλθὼν κατῴκησεν εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ τὴν παραθαλασσίαν ἐν ὁρίοις Ζαβουλὼν καὶ Νεφθαλίμ
verses.transliteration: kai katalipōn tēn Nazara elthōn katōkēsen eis Kapharnaoum tēn parathalassian en horiois Zaboulōn kai Nephthalim
verses.literal: Leaving Nazareth He went and lived in Capernaum which is by the sea in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali

verses.original: ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος
verses.transliteration: hina plērōthē to rhēthen dia Ēsaiou tou prophētou legontos
verses.literal: to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah

verses.original: Γῆ Ζαβουλὼν καὶ γῆ Νεφθαλίμ ὁδὸν θαλάσσης πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου Γαλιλαία τῶν ἐθνῶν
verses.transliteration: Gē Zaboulōn kai gē Nephthalim hodon thalassēs peran tou Iordanou Galilaia tōn ethnōn
verses.literal: Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali the Way of the Sea beyond the Jordan Galilee of the Gentiles

verses.original: ὁ λαὸς ὁ καθήμενος ἐν σκοτίᾳ φῶς εἶδεν μέγα καὶ τοῖς καθημένοις ἐν χώρᾳ καὶ σκιᾷ θανάτου φῶς ἀνέτειλεν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: ho laos ho kathēmenos en skotia phōs eiden mega kai tois kathēmenois en chōra kai skia thanatou phōs aneteilen autois
verses.literal: the people living in darkness have seen a great light on those living in the land of the shadow of death a light has dawned

verses.original: Ἀπὸ τότε ἤρξατο ὁ Ἰησοῦς κηρύσσειν καὶ λέγειν Μετανοεῖτε ἤγγικεν γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: Apo tote ērxato ho Iēsous kēryssein kai legein Metanoeite ēngiken gar hē basileia tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: From that time on Jesus began to preach - Repent for the kingdom of heaven is near

verses.original: Περιπατῶν δὲ παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν τῆς Γαλιλαίας εἶδεν δύο ἀδελφούς Σίμωνα τὸν λεγόμενον Πέτρον καὶ Ἀνδρέαν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ βάλλοντας ἀμφίβληστρον εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν ἦσαν γὰρ ἁλιεῖς
verses.transliteration: Peripatōn de para tēn thalassan tēs Galilaias eiden dyo adelphous Simōna ton legomenon Petron kai Andrean ton adelphon autou ballontas amphiblēstron eis tēn thalassan ēsan gar halieis
verses.literal: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee He saw two brothers Simon called Peter and his brother Andrew They were casting a net into the sea for they were fishermen

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Δεῦτε ὀπίσω μου καὶ ποιήσω ὑμᾶς ἁλιεῖς ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: kai legei autois Deute opisō mou kai poiēsō hymas halieis anthrōpōn
verses.literal: Come, follow . . . Me Jesus said and I will make you fishers of men

verses.original: οἱ δὲ εὐθέως ἀφέντες τὰ δίκτυα ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: hoi de eutheōs aphentes ta diktya ēkolouthēsan autō
verses.literal: And at once they left their nets and followed Him

verses.original: Καὶ προβὰς ἐκεῖθεν εἶδεν ἄλλους δύο ἀδελφούς Ἰάκωβον τὸν τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ μετὰ Ζεβεδαίου τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν καταρτίζοντας τὰ δίκτυα αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Kai probas ekeithen eiden allous dyo adelphous Iakōbon ton tou Zebedaiou kai Iōannēn ton adelphon autou en tō ploiō meta Zebedaiou tou patros autōn katartizontas ta diktya autōn kai ekalesen autous
verses.literal: Going on from there He saw two other brothers James son of Zebedee and his brother John They were in a boat with their father Zebedee mending their nets Jesus called them

verses.original: οἱ δὲ εὐθέως ἀφέντες τὸ πλοῖον καὶ τὸν πατέρα αὐτῶν ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: hoi de eutheōs aphentes to ploion kai ton patera autōn ēkolouthēsan autō
verses.literal: and immediately they left the boat and their father and followed Him

verses.original: Καὶ περιῆγεν ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ διδάσκων ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς αὐτῶν καὶ κηρύσσων τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς βασιλείας καὶ θεραπεύων πᾶσαν νόσον καὶ πᾶσαν μαλακίαν ἐν τῷ λαῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai periēgen en holē tē Galilaia didaskōn en tais synagōgais autōn kai kēryssōn to euangelion tēs basileias kai therapeuōn pasan noson kai pasan malakian en tō laō
verses.literal: Jesus went throughout . . . Galilee teaching in their synagogues preaching the gospel of the kingdom and healing every disease and sickness among the people

verses.original: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ἡ ἀκοὴ αὐτοῦ εἰς ὅλην τὴν Συρίαν καὶ προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ πάντας τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας ποικίλαις νόσοις καὶ βασάνοις συνεχομένους καὶ δαιμονιζομένους καὶ σεληνιαζομένους καὶ παραλυτικούς καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: kai apēlthen hē akoē autou eis holēn tēn Syrian kai prosēnenkan autō pantas tous kakōs echontas poikilais nosois kai basanois synechomenous kai daimonizomenous kai selēniazomenous kai paralytikous kai etherapeusen autous
verses.literal: News about Him spread all over Syria and people brought to Him all who were ill with various diseases those suffering acute pain the demon-possessed those having seizures and the paralyzed and He healed them

verses.original: Καὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοὶ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ Δεκαπόλεως καὶ Ἱεροσολύμων καὶ Ἰουδαίας καὶ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου
verses.transliteration: Kai ēkolouthēsan autō ochloi polloi apo tēs Galilaias kai Dekapoleōs kai Hierosolymōn kai Ioudaias kai peran tou Iordanou
verses.literal: Large crowds followed Him having come from Galilee the Decapolis Jerusalem Judea and beyond the Jordan
